s.how: Whisk 150g flour, 2 tbsp custard powder, 2 tsp baking powder and 80g sugar. Add 2 eggs and 200ml evaporated milk plus 100ml water and whisk smooth. Rest 30 minutes. Cook in a hot greased egg waffle pan for 3 minutes a side until crisp and golden.

s.note: a Hong Kong street stall classic
s.how: Fry 2 tbsp curry powder and crushed garlic in oil for a minute. Add 400ml coconut milk, a spoon of sugar and a little water and simmer 5 minutes. Add 500g fish balls and simmer for 10 minutes until hot through. Thread onto skewers and spoon over the sauce.

m.note: the night before the final fight
m.how: Slice 600g rump steak thinly and marinate in soy and a spoon of cornflour for 20 minutes. Stir-fry hard in a very hot wok, then add sliced onion, green capsicum and garlic. Finish with oyster sauce and a big spoon of cracked black pepper. Serve over jasmine rice.

w.how: Cut puff pastry into rounds and press into a patty tin. Whisk 3 eggs with 150ml milk, 100ml evaporated milk and 80g sugar until dissolved, then strain until silky. Fill the cases and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until just set and still wobbly in the centre.

d.note: the cha chaan teng café round the corner
d.how: Simmer 6 black tea bags in 750ml water for 5 minutes until very strong. Strain through a fine cloth or sieve into a jug. Stir in evaporated milk and sugar to taste. Serve hot in cups, or chill and pour over ice in tall glasses.
